params.note: Catalog v6.0 (D-B079, D-B100): catalog v4.1 events relocated with NonLinLoc in the re-inverted merged model v0.4.1, with source-specific station terms (NLL-SSST) and waveform-coherence relocation (NLL-coherence), on the re-timed and clock-corrected picks (v4.1tc); events NonLinLoc does not locate have no hypocentre.
params.magnitudes_text: Magnitudes: converged Route A preferred magnitudes (D-B091; M, M_type ML / Mw / Mw_cal): the catalog v5.1 table (computed with v5.1 hypocentres) where it has the event, else the v4.1 table (v4 hypocentres); magnitude_source names which. They are not recomputed with the v6.0 hypocentres.
params.hypocentres_text: Hypocentres: NonLinLoc (EDT likelihood, oct-tree) in the 3D merged Vp/Vs model v{model} (velocity_models.zip in this record), with source-specific station terms and coherence relocation (below), run {run}. Depth is km below sea level (true depth; the Earth-flattening of the travel-time grids is undone). station_terms_v{version}.in: the static terms of the first pass, used only by the deep and edge passes.
params.picks_note: Picks: Cascadia_picks_catalog_v4.1tc.csv.gz in this folder: the v4.1 picks re-timed on drifting channels (v4.1t, D-B072/D-B075) plus the clock-drift corrections of MH07.XD and MG07.XD (spring 2016, D-B090; columns clock_correction_s, clock_correction_sd_s, clock_epoch, clock_flag, total_correction_s). The other candidate clock epochs of the station screen are not applied (PI review, v6.1). Method: pick_timing_README.md.

columns.M, M_unc, M_type, ML, ML_unc, n_ML, ML_m: converged Route A magnitudes (D-B091); magnitude_source names the table
columns.magnitude_source: v5.1_converged (computed with v5.1 hypocentres) or v4.1_converged (v4 hypocentres), D-B091; empty without a magnitude
columns.rms_unweighted: unweighted rms of the residuals of the arrivals used (s); rms is NonLinLoc's EDT-weighted value (D-B069)
columns.shift_h_v51_km, shift_z_v51_km: change from catalog v5.1 (horizontal; depth, positive = deeper), when both are located
columns.model_version: velocity model of the travel-time grids (v0.4.1)
columns.loc_pass: NonLinLoc run of the hypocentre: ssst_it4 (final SSST pass), coherence, deep or edge
columns.station_terms: ssst (NLL-SSST, characteristic distances 9999-16-8-4 km) or static (deep and edge passes)
columns.ssst_char_km: final Loc2ssst characteristic distance of the event's station terms (4 km; empty for static rows)
columns.coherence_relocated: relocated by the NLL-coherence stage (compact location density, Len3 <= 5 km)
columns.coherence_partners: neighbours with pair coherence >= 0.5 and a compact density, stacked for the event
columns.coherence_skipped_region: compact event not coherence-relocated because it lies in the Mendocino region (D-B098); SSST location kept
columns.edge_pass: hypocentre from the edge pass (event rejected at a lateral face of its SSST tile box)
columns.n_picks_retimed: picks of the event re-timed from a short waveform read (D-B072/D-B075)
columns.n_picks_clock_corrected: picks of the event corrected for a confirmed station clock drift (D-B090)
columns.review_problems, review_auto_indicators: v5.1 location review: problem groups and automatic indicators, ';'-joined (indicators, not verdicts; D-B097)
columns.review_not_earthquake, review_depth_unre: reviewer verdict columns, empty in this version (D-B097)

method_notes: Model v0.4.1 (D-B083): the merged tomography model re-inverted with the re-timed picks (v0.4.0, D-B082) and the tomoDD surface floor (D-B081) in the inversion. Travel-time grids as for v5.1: merged solid surface (D-B068), fine and wide grids, deep pass below 80 km (D-B067).

Source-specific station terms (NLL-SSST, Loc2ssst; Lomax & Savvaidis 2022): four passes with characteristic distances 9999, 16, 8 and 4 km (D-B095, D-B096) replace v5.1's static terms; the deep and edge passes use the static terms of the first pass (column station_terms).

Coherence relocation (NLL-coherence, Lomax & Savvaidis 2022): an event with a compact location density is relocated on its density stacked with those of its waveform-coherent neighbours (pair coherence from waveform cross-correlation, D-B040), the relative-relocation step chosen for B5 (D-B078, D-B084). Not applied in the Mendocino region (D-B098; column coherence_skipped_region).
Edge pass: events rejected at a lateral face of their tile box are located again in a box centred on them (column edge_pass).
event_flag also marks events that ComCat lists as explosions, quarry blasts or other non-earthquakes (D-B071).
review_* columns: the automatic indicators of the v5.1 location review (D-B097); no reviewer verdict is applied in this version.
known_limits: Axial depths: {axial}. The SSST passes deepen Axial by 0.22 km (median; before them 82.7 % of tier A-B events were within 2 km of the seafloor, v5.1 81 %, target 85 %). Median depth changes from the SSST passes elsewhere: Puget +0.29, Mendocino +0.17, Blanco +0.15, Gorda -0.22, offshore forearc -0.15 km. Blanco Ridge and the Gorda Depression come out deeper against Lange et al. (2026). To be fixed in v6.1 (D-B100); acceptance report: b4_acceptance_v6.0.html.
Model v0.4.1, not v0.4.2 (D-B099): v0.4.2 removes event self-pairs from the inversion data and adds a tomoDD numerical fix; the difference is local (Vs near 29 km depth under Vancouver Island).
No coherence relocation in the Mendocino region (D-B098; 11,148 events keep their final SSST location): on the one Mendocino test cluster coherence made the held-out fit worse. Provisional.

Deferred to v6.1 (D-B097): the weekly artificial signal on UW analog stations near Mount St Helens (HSR, EDM, STD.UW; candidate false deep events), the other candidate station clock epochs (including the Axial cabled array, Dec 2014 - Jan 2015), and the reviewer verdicts (review_not_earthquake, review_depth_unreliable, review_relocate, review_depth_km empty).
Magnitudes are not recomputed with the v6.0 hypocentres (magnitude_source).
floor_limited, far_only and five_phase events have poorly constrained depths, as in v5.1 (counts above).
